scripts.test: npm run engine:test && npm run build
scripts.engine:test:compile: tsc app/engine.ts app/engine-resources.ts --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --module ES2022 --moduleResolution bundler --outDir .engine-test --skipLibCheck
scripts.engine:test: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-parity.mjs && node scripts/engine-resource-test.mjs
scripts.engine:test:full: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-parity.mjs --full && node scripts/engine-resource-test.mjs
scripts.engine:test:stress: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-parity.mjs --full --random 100000 && node scripts/engine-resource-test.mjs
scripts.engine:test:million: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-parity.mjs --full --random 1000000 && node scripts/engine-resource-test.mjs
scripts.engine:benchmark: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-benchmark.mjs
scripts.engine:benchmark:pool: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-pool-benchmark.mjs
scripts.engine:benchmark:selective: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-selective-benchmark.mjs
scripts.engine:benchmark:accuracy: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-accuracy-benchmark.mjs
scripts.engine:benchmark:matrix: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-performance-matrix.mjs
scripts.engine:audit: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-root-audit.mjs
scripts.engine:match: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/engine-match.mjs
scripts.engine:data: npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test:compile && node scripts/generate-training-data.mjs
